QUESTION:
What is the default value of `auth.log_level` in the current version of PaderQueue?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0800] config | auth.log_level | version 4.x
# `auth.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `info` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | auth |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `auth.log_level` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[auth]
log_level = "info"
```

---

[d0575] config | scheduler.log_level (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `scheduler.log_level` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `error` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.log_level` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
log_level = "error"
```

[d0234] config | metrics.log_level | version 4.x
# `metrics.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `warn` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | metrics |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `metrics.log_level` only if you observe problems with the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
log_level = "warn"
```
